regions.text: あろ。すなはち願を上下に動かして物を噛む形である。

quote.translation: Yi, with Zhen below and Gen above, has the figure ䷚, that is, the shape of jaws moving up and down to bite.

regions.text: 感嗑が願と違ふのは四爻目に堅い腸爻が偶然來てゐることである。

quote.translation: Shihe differs from Yi in that a hard yang line has come by chance into the fourth place.

regions.text: 教侮に「願中有物日瞬盛」とぁる。次で『登嗑而亭、剛柔分、動而明筋電合而章」と云つてるるが燃嘟す」も剛柔分ろ」も「電電合ふ」もいづれもみな震と離との偶然選近に基いた規定である。

quote.translation: The Tuan zhuan says, "When there is something between the jaws, it is called Shihe", and goes on: "Biting through, and so success; the firm and the yielding are divided; movement and brightness; thunder and lightning unite and become manifest".

regions.text: 「嘘盛す」のは三三の頑覺印象に基いてゐる。

quote.translation: "Biting together", "the firm and the yielding are divided" and "thunder and lightning unite" are all determinations based on the contingent Encounter of Zhen and Li.

regions.text: 基いてゐる。「剛柔分る」は震が

quote.translation: "Biting together" rests on the visual impression of ䷔.

regions.text: 「剛柔分る」は震が陽卦で剛、離が陰卦で柔である、からである。

quote.translation: "The firm and the yielding are divided" because Zhen is a yang trigram and so firm, whilst Li is a yin trigram and so yielding.

regions.text: 「雷電合ふ」は震が電で離が火であつて、火が電と解されてゐるからである。

quote.translation: "Thunder and lightning unite" because Zhen is thunder and Li is fire, and the fire is understood as lightning.

regions.text: つてるるがこの柔とは五爻目の陰を指してゐてこ

quote.translation: The commentary also says, "The yielding attains the centre and moves upward".

regions.text: 更に『柔得中而上行』と云つてるるがこの柔とは五爻目の陰を指してゐてこの陰が外の中すなはち中央にばつたり行営つてゐることに蒸いてすらすらと上の方へ行くのである。

quote.translation: This "yielding" is the yin line in the fifth place, and it moves smoothly upward because it has landed squarely on the centre, the middle place, of the outer trigram.

regions.text: また『不驚位」と云ってるるのは、五爻目は陽の位であるのに偶然そこへ陰爻が來てゐることを云つてゐる。

quote.translation: When it says "not in its proper place" (不當位), it means that the fifth place is a yang position and yet a yin line has come there by chance.

regions.text: 辭に「六三磁胱肉選毒」とあるが、肉を噛んで毒にぶつかつたといふのは三冷目が陽の位でありながらたまたま陰爻がそこへ来てるる偶然性を解釋したのである。

quote.translation: The line statements say, "Six in the third place: biting dried meat, one meets poison", and biting into meat and striking poison interprets the contingency that a yin line happens to have come into the third place, although that place is a yang position.

regions.text: 「九四、唯乾肺得金矢』とあるのは、乾肺すなはち管つきの乾いた肉を噛んだところが情の中に矢の根が残つてるたのである。

quote.translation: "Nine in the fourth place: biting dried meat on the bone, one gets a metal arrow" means that on biting into dried meat on the bone one found an arrowhead left in the bone.

regions.text: この偶然性は四爻目に，

quote.translation: This contingency interprets the contingency of a hard yang line having come into the fourth place, and the interpretation is endorsed by the fact that a yang line stands in a yin position and also, of itself, by the impression that the figure ䷔ makes on the eye.
